Bibliotecas de terceiros usadas no navegador (copiadas sem alteração, para funcionar sem internet):

- SheetJS Community Edition 0.18.5 (xlsx.full.min.js), licença Apache-2.0, https://sheetjs.com
- jsPDF 2.5.1 (jspdf.umd.min.js), licença MIT, https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF
- jsPDF-AutoTable 3.5.31 (jspdf.plugin.autotable.min.js), licença MIT, https://github.com/simonbengtsson/jsPDF-AutoTable
